projection.field_chart: physical G=-native G; physical k=-native k; E/D=diag(-1,-1,1) raw, H=-diag(-1,-1,1) raw for exp(-i omega t); native display ftinv is not used

layer_geometry_reports.disjointness: Conservative periodic Cartesian enclosures; exact circle separation where applicable
layer_geometry_reports.limitation: Noncircular shapes whose bounding rectangles intersect are conservatively rejected even if the shapes may be disjoint

projection.normalization: Each primitive native field divided by sqrt(N_cells); supercell integral gives N_cells times allowed primitive overlap, so net factor is one. No division by cell area after native field normalization.
projection.convention: E=sum E_G exp(+i(G+k).r); delta epsilon=sum delta[p,r] chi_r exp(+ipQ.r-ipOmega t); M=I+integral E*delta_epsilon E; K=W inv(M) W
projection.loss_ownership: Material projection only. Export native sector radiation separately; no radiation, absorption, gain or QNM metric is inserted.
projection.scope: Finite selected momentum/modal window. No forced edge closure, global Bloch certificate, dynamic radiation or continuum completeness.

common_frequency_bath.approximation: Freeze a true common-positive-real-frequency sample; no reactive shift or sideband-resolved radiation
common_frequency_bath.approximation_scope: Weak collective radiation and narrowband native modal frequencies at fixed k and pump-independent bath
common_frequency_bath.phase_convention: C transforms as U^dagger C; emitted amplitude is C^dagger a
